text:
Leah: Quick design review — attached mock of a /compare view in a new "card mode" (mobile-first). Two quick asks: 1) should filters live in a collapsible rail or a modal? 2) pin/version UX — does this feel discoverable? 3) performance badges: color + copy nits. Screenshot: <link>
Ravi: Card mode looks cleaner on narrow screens. For desktop I still like table for density. If we ship both, make the toggle persistent per-user (local storage).
Ravi: Filters — collapsible rail is fine but make active filters visible as chips in the header so users don’t have to open the rail to see what’s applied.
Marta: Accessibility nits: performance badges lack contrast (green on pale bg). We need 4.5:1 text contrast or add an outline. Also badges should expose aria-label: e.g. aria-label="Latency 32ms (p95)" so screen readers get the score+metric.
Ethan: Pinning — current pin icon in the mock is subtle. Suggest: replace standalone pin with a left-side checkbox + primary "Compare pinned" action in a sticky footer. That also helps multi-select comparisons.
Leah: Good call on multi-select. Would that add cognitive load? Might we confuse quick pin (single) vs compare (multi)?
Ethan: We can keep both. Single-click pin keeps model pinned for quick lookups; shift/checkbox enters multi-select. Tooltip copy: "Pin version to catalog" is clearer than just "Pin".
Marta: Keyboard flow: ensure filter toggle is reachable via `Tab`, and pin checkboxes are announced when focused. Focus order: filters -> item list -> compare tray -> modal actions. Also add skip-link for screen readers: "Skip to compare".
Ravi: UX copy: performance badges currently say "Perf: 32" — change to "Latency (p95): 32ms". Also add hover state showing test workload and dataset.
Leah: Small accessibility decision: do we convert badges to icons+text or keep full text? Icons help scan but must include hidden text for SRs.
Marta: Keep text + optional icon. Icon alone fails a11y.
Leah: Quick implementation note for eng: sample filter state we'll read out in console tests:
Leah: ```
{
  "filters": ["gpu:rtx6000","quant:4bit"],
  "mode": "card",
  "pinned": ["v1.2.3"]
}
```
Ravi: Devops/infra question — will pinned versions be stored in account prefs or per-org? If per-account, ensure private deployments sync.
Ethan: Recommend per-account default + org-level override. We'll need an API endpoint /users/:id/pins.
DesignBot: Reminder: design sync on this thread scheduled Tue 2pm in Fika. Please bring a11y checklist.
Leah: Decisions from thread: 1) expose both card/table with persistent toggle 2) filters collapse + active chips in header 3) change pin affordance: single pin + checkbox multi-select + clearer tooltip 4) badge contrast + aria-label + more descriptive copy 5) keyboard/focus skip-link. I'll collate into PRD and share next steps. :thumbsup:
